title: On the inductive Giannelli-McKay condition for sporadic groups
summary: We present a computational framework to verify a refinement of the McKay conjecture, proposed by E. Giannelli, for sporadic simple groups and their universal covers. This refinement asserts the existence of a bijection between the $p'$-characters of a finite group and those of the normalizer of its Sylow $p$-subgroup that does not increase character degrees. Our verification enforces stricter conditions, ensuring equivariance under the relevant outer automorphism group, preservation of the $p$-part of the character conductor, and compatibility with central characters.
